name: paper_small
_comment: Reads at the PAPER's record shape (2026-10-07, plan H5 scaled down).  bench_bftree.rs inserts
key=value with 16 B keys, so a record is ~32 B; our usual arms use 100 B values, where a
mini-page is only ~2x denser per cached record than a 4 KiB leaf.  Here the question is whether
the paper's ~2x point-read win appears once records are small.
Scaled: 20M rows x 16 B values (not 100M), budgets 32 MiB and 128 MiB, direct I/O, unified pool,
both zipf arms (raw = the paper's, scrambled = YCSB's).  Warmup sized to fill the ring:
a 128 MiB ring holds ~1.5M small records at 30% promotion -> >= 5M misses.
